notes.title: RELEASE v2.0.000
notes.content:
In this update:

- All playable units or buildings have been redefined in their design
- All units have been resized upwards for better visibility
- Projectiles have been resized upwards for better visibility

We're looking to improve the game, don't hesitate to communicate in the "discussion" section!

notes.title: Release 1.1 !
notes.content:
Release Update 1.1.000 for Sadness of Valor !
I try as much as possible to have time to fix various bugs and produce improvements.

Find all sinificative modifications for the release below:
- Reduce amount of resources needed for build (Buildings, units, upgrades, etc.)
- Reduce build time
- Reduce amount of resources at start of a game
- Increase speed of units movement
- Increase speed of units turret rotation
- Increase upgrade factor for damage and health
- Matchmaking is now unavailable for player vs player

notes.title: Update of Package size and optimization !
notes.content: It was time to explore the possibilities of optimization! The game is functional but lacks optimization. I'm trying to do my best to change that.
